tips.label: 基本句型
tips.text: 主詞＋have／has＋過去分詞。I、you、we、they 用 have；第三人稱單數用 has。

tips.label: 經驗
tips.text: ever 問「曾經」，never 表示「從未」；before、once、twice 可描述經驗。

tips.label: 持續至今
tips.text: for＋一段時間；since＋過去時間點或過去式子句。問持續多久用 How long。

tips.label: 完成與未完成
tips.text: already 表示已經，just 表示剛剛；否定句與問句常在句尾加 yet。

tips.label: 問答
tips.text: Have／Has＋主詞＋過去分詞？回答 Yes, 主詞＋have／has. 或 No, 主詞＋haven't／hasn't.

tips.label: 經驗與去向
tips.text: have been to 表示曾去過；have gone to 表示已前往、尚未回來。

tips.label: 時態判斷
tips.text: yesterday 等明確過去時間通常用過去式；從過去持續到現在或累積到現在的經驗用現在完成式。

notes.title: 現在完成式的結構與過去分詞
notes.description: 表達截至目前的經驗、從過去持續到現在的狀態，以及與現在有關的已完成動作。規則動詞常加 -ed；copy → copied、try → tried；常用不規則變化有 be → been、go → gone、do → done、take → taken、see → seen、write → written、understand → understood、bring → brought、put → put。不可把過去式 went、did 當成過去分詞。
examples: I have taken three photos.（我已經拍了三張照片。）
She has done the dishes.（她已經洗完碗了。）

notes.title: 否定句與縮寫
notes.description: have not＝haven't；has not＝hasn't。I have＝I've、you have＝you've、we have＝we've、they have＝they've；he has＝he's、she has＝she's、it has＝it's。's 也可能是 is，須看後面的句型與語意。never 本身帶否定意思，不再加 not。
examples: He's woken up.＝He has woken up.（他已經醒來了。）
He's dancing.＝He is dancing.（他正在跳舞。）
We haven't read the letter yet.（我們還沒讀那封信。）

notes.title: 表達經驗：ever、never、before 與次數
notes.rule: 主詞＋have／has＋（never）＋過去分詞；Have／Has＋主詞＋ever＋過去分詞？
notes.description: ever 常用在問句詢問曾經的經驗；never 表示到目前為止從未做過。before 常放句尾。once、twice、three times 表示經驗次數，前面不加 for 或 since。
examples: Have you ever been abroad?（你曾經出過國嗎？）
I have never cheated on a test.（我從未在考試中作弊。）
She has won the race twice.（她已經贏過這項競賽兩次。）

notes.title: 現在完成式問答與次數問句
notes.rule: Have／Has＋主詞＋過去分詞？；How many times＋have／has＋主詞＋過去分詞？
notes.description: 一般問句把 have／has 移到主詞前。簡答必須呼應完成式助動詞，不可改用 do／does／did。How many times 問「到目前為止幾次」，回答次數。
examples: Has Amy read the letter? Yes, she has.（艾咪讀過信了嗎？是，她讀過了。）
Have they cleaned the gym? No, they haven't.（他們清理好體育館了嗎？不，還沒有。）
How many times have you read this book? Three times.（這本書你讀過幾次？三次。）

notes.title: 持續至今：for 與 since
notes.rule: 主詞＋have／has＋過去分詞＋for＋一段時間／since＋過去起點
notes.description: for 後接 three days、two years 等時間長度；since 後接 2020、this morning 等起點，也可接一般過去式子句。主句用現在完成式，表示動作或狀態持續至今。
examples: I have known Amanda for two years.（我已經認識亞曼達兩年了。）
We have lived here since 2020.（我們從 2020 年就住在這裡。）
Mary has played the piano since she was eight.（瑪莉從八歲起就開始彈鋼琴。）

notes.title: How long 詢問持續多久
notes.description: How long 問持續時間，可用 for＋一段時間或 since＋起點作答；和詢問次數的 How many times 不同。
examples: How long has Mark been on a diet? For a month.（馬克節食多久了？一個月了。）
How long have you lived here? Since 2020.（你在這裡住多久了？從 2020 年開始。）

notes.title: 持續狀態的補充句型
notes.rule: have／has＋always＋過去分詞；It has been＋一段時間＋since＋過去式子句
notes.description: always 可表達從過去到現在一直如此。It has been... since... 表示某事件發生至今多久。How have you been lately? 用來詢問熟人最近過得如何。
examples: I've always wanted to visit Japan.（我一直想去日本。）
It has been five years since Kyle moved here.（凱爾搬來這裡已經五年了。）
How have you been lately? Great!（你最近過得如何？很好！）

notes.title: 已經、剛剛與尚未完成
notes.description: already 表示「已經」，可在過去分詞前或句尾；just 表示「剛剛」，常在過去分詞前。yet 表示「還（沒）／已經……了嗎」，常在否定句或問句句尾。already 與 just 都能用於肯定句，須依語境判斷意思。
examples: I have already had lunch.＝I have had lunch already.（我已經吃過午餐了。）
Karen has just done the dishes.（凱倫剛剛洗完碗。）
Paul hasn't finished his homework yet.（保羅還沒寫完功課。）
Have you walked the dog yet?（你已經遛過狗了嗎？）

notes.title: 現在完成式與過去式
notes.rule: 現在完成式連結過去與現在；一般過去式描述過去特定時間
notes.description: yesterday、last night 或交代過去事件的 when 子句，通常搭配一般過去式。若說從過去起點持續到現在，使用現在完成式；不要把有明確已結束過去時間的句子直接套入現在完成式。
examples: Leo took a photo yesterday.（里歐昨天拍了一張照片。）
Leo has taken three photos so far.（里歐到目前為止已拍了三張照片。）
My aunt has lived in Taipei since she got married.（我阿姨從結婚起就一直住在臺北。）

notes.title: been to 與 gone to
notes.rule: have／has been to＋地點；have／has gone to＋地點
notes.description: been to 表示曾經到過某處，常搭配經驗次數；gone to 表示已前往某處，通常尚未回來。副詞 abroad、there、here 前不加 to。
examples: I have been to Japan twice.（我曾去過日本兩次。）
Dan has gone to the airport. He is still there.（丹去機場了，他還在那裡。）
She has never been abroad.（她從未出過國。）

notes.title: 現在完成式的附加問句
notes.rule: 肯定句＋haven't／hasn't＋代名詞？；否定句＋have／has＋代名詞？
notes.description: 附加問句使用 have／has，並依主詞選擇相同的助動詞。前肯定後否定，前否定後肯定；never 具有否定意思，因此後面用肯定附加問句。
examples: You have heard the news, haven't you?（你已經聽說那則消息了，不是嗎？）
Manson has never been to a concert, has he?（曼森從未去過演唱會，對吧？）
They haven't finished yet, have they?（他們還沒完成，對吧？）

notes.title: 課本補充：推測過去發生的事情
notes.description: must have＋過去分詞表示對過去的強烈推測「一定已經……」；may／might／could have＋過去分詞可表示「可能曾經……」。情態助動詞後用原形 have，即使主詞是 he／she，也不能改成 has。此處聚焦課本的推測用法；could have 在其他語境也有不同意思。
examples: Bella is crying. She must have heard the bad news.（貝拉在哭，她一定已經聽說那個壞消息了。）
Ken may have forgotten to close the windows.（肯可能忘了關窗戶。）

quiz.question: My sister ___ already taken three photos of the race.
quiz.hint: 主詞 My sister 是第三人稱單數，現在完成式用 has＋過去分詞 taken。

quiz.question: The teenagers ___ just cleaned the gym.
quiz.hint: The teenagers 是複數，現在完成式用 have＋過去分詞 cleaned。

quiz.question: I have never ___ on a test.
quiz.hint: have never 後面接過去分詞；cheat 的過去分詞是 cheated。

quiz.question: She has already ___ these words into her notebook.
quiz.hint: has already 後接過去分詞；copy 要把 y 改成 i，再加 ed，成為 copied。

quiz.question: We have ___ this kind of tea before.
quiz.hint: have＋過去分詞表示曾有的經驗；try 的過去分詞是 tried。

quiz.question: My parents have never ___ abroad.
quiz.hint: have never 後面需要過去分詞；be 的過去分詞是 been。

quiz.question: ___ you ever met a pop star?
quiz.hint: 現在完成式問句把 Have 放在主詞 you 前，後面接過去分詞 met。

quiz.question: ___ your brother ever won a race?
quiz.hint: 主詞 your brother 是第三人稱單數，現在完成式問句用 Has＋主詞＋過去分詞。

quiz.question: A: Has Amy read the letter yet? B: Yes, she ___.
quiz.hint: 問句用 Has Amy...，肯定簡答要呼應助動詞：Yes, she has.

quiz.question: A: Have the boys taken out the garbage yet? B: No, they ___.
quiz.hint: 問句用 Have the boys...，否定簡答為 No, they haven't.

quiz.question: ___ have you visited this gym? — Three times.
quiz.hint: 回答 Three times 表示次數，因此用 How many times 詢問到目前為止的經驗次數。

quiz.question: I have read this letter ___ so far.
quiz.hint: twice 可直接表示兩次，不加 for 或 since；two time 應為 two times。

quiz.question: My brother has played the drums ___ three years.
quiz.hint: three years 是一段持續時間，現在完成式用 for＋一段時間。

quiz.question: We have known this teenager ___ 2020.
quiz.hint: 2020 是過去的時間點，用 since 表示自該年持續至今。

quiz.question: She has loved pop music since she ___ ten.
quiz.hint: since 後面的子句交代過去的起點，這裡要用過去式 was。

quiz.question: ___ has your dad been on a diet? — For a month.
quiz.hint: For a month 是持續時間，用 How long 詢問已持續多久。

quiz.question: My sister ___ at this senior high school since 2022 and still teaches there.
quiz.hint: since 2022 和 still teaches there 表示從過去持續至今，使用現在完成式 has taught。

quiz.question: I ___ this habit when I was a child, but I don't have it now.
quiz.hint: when I was a child 指過去時間，且現在已沒有此習慣，用過去式 had。

quiz.question: A: Where is Jack? B: He has ___ to the gym. He is still there.
quiz.hint: He is still there 表示尚未回來，使用 has gone to；been to 表示曾去過的經驗。

quiz.question: Amy has ___ to Japan three times, and she is at home now.
quiz.hint: three times 表示經驗次數，且現在已回家，使用 has been to。

quiz.question: She ___ finished her letter yet.
quiz.hint: yet 搭配現在完成式否定句；主詞 She 用 hasn't＋過去分詞 finished。

quiz.question: Have you put the stamp on the envelope ___?
quiz.hint: 現在完成式問句句尾可用 yet，詢問動作是否已完成；since、for 後須有時間內容。

quiz.question: We ___ already taken action to help the unhappy child.
quiz.hint: 主詞 We 用 have，構成 have already＋過去分詞 taken。

quiz.question: Karen has just ___ the dishes.
quiz.hint: has just 後接過去分詞；do 的過去分詞是 done，did 是過去式。

quiz.question: He has ___ met that star, so this will be their first meeting.
quiz.hint: 後句說將是第一次見面，表示至今從未見過；never 放在 has 與過去分詞 met 之間。

quiz.question: You have heard about the race, ___ you?
quiz.hint: 主要子句是肯定的現在完成式，附加問句用否定的 haven't you。

quiz.question: Mia has never cheated on a test, ___ she?
quiz.hint: never 使主要子句具有否定意思，附加問句用肯定的 has she。

quiz.question: Your parents haven't read the letter, ___ they?
quiz.hint: 主要子句是現在完成式否定句，附加問句要用肯定的 have they。

quiz.question: He's already ___ the drum into the gym.
quiz.hint: 這裡 He's 是 He has 的縮寫，後面接過去分詞 carried。

quiz.question: I ___ collected stamps since I was nine.
quiz.hint: 主詞 I 搭配 have；since I was nine 表示從九歲持續至今。

quiz.question: It has been two years since we ___ to this city.
quiz.hint: It has been＋一段時間＋since 子句，since 後用過去式 moved 表示搬家的起點。

quiz.question: I haven't seen you for months. How ___ you been lately?
quiz.hint: 詢問近況使用 How have you been lately?，you 搭配 have。

quiz.question: She has always ___ to stay in shape.
quiz.hint: has always 後接過去分詞；want 的過去分詞是 wanted。

quiz.question: We haven't talked to him ___ this morning.
quiz.hint: this morning 是開始的時間點，用 since 表示從今天早上到現在。

quiz.question: The children have been worried about their dog ___ two days.
quiz.hint: two days 是持續的時間長度，因此使用 for。

quiz.question: How long ___ your brother had this drum?
quiz.hint: 主詞 your brother 是第三人稱單數，完成式問句用 has；had 是 have 的過去分詞。

quiz.question: He has ___ me into joining the race.
quiz.hint: has 後接過去分詞 talked；本題考現在完成式的動詞形式。

quiz.question: My family has ___ this dog Lucky since it was little.
quiz.hint: has 後接過去分詞 called，表示從過去到現在都這樣稱呼牠。

quiz.question: I have already ___ the letter in an envelope.
quiz.hint: put 的原形、過去式和過去分詞同形；have already 後仍使用過去分詞 put。

quiz.question: She has never ___ why he is so angry.
quiz.hint: understand 的過去分詞是不規則變化 understood；has never 後接過去分詞。

quiz.question: This game has ___ us a lot of joy.
quiz.hint: has 後需要過去分詞；bring 的過去分詞是 brought。

quiz.question: ___ the teacher raised her hand yet?
quiz.hint: 主詞 the teacher 是第三人稱單數，現在完成式問句用 Has＋主詞＋過去分詞 raised。

quiz.question: My sister ___ slim since she was a teenager.
quiz.hint: since she was a teenager 表示從青少年時期持續至今，狀態用 has been＋形容詞。

quiz.question: They have already ___ as much garbage as possible.
quiz.hint: have already 後接過去分詞 collected；as much garbage as possible 是句子素材。

quiz.question: A: Have you ever tried this type of exercise? B: Yes, I ___.
quiz.hint: Have you ever... 的肯定簡答是 Yes, I have.，沿用完成式助動詞。

quiz.question: The students have ___ an interest in pop music.
quiz.hint: have 後接過去分詞；show 的過去分詞可用 shown。

quiz.question: Leo ___ a photo of the star yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 是明確的過去時間，應用過去式 took，不能用現在完成式。

quiz.question: A: Why is Bella crying? B: She must ___ the bad news already.
quiz.hint: 推測過去發生的事情用 must＋have＋過去分詞；情態助動詞後的 have 保持原形。

quiz.question: Ken may ___ to close the windows before he left.
quiz.hint: may＋have＋過去分詞表示可能曾經發生的事；forget 的過去分詞是 forgotten。

quiz.question: The boys ___ taken out the garbage yet, so the bags are still in the kitchen.
quiz.hint: 垃圾仍在廚房表示尚未完成；複數主詞 The boys 用 haven't＋過去分詞 taken。

vocab.sentence: I haven't had breakfast yet.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我還沒吃早餐。

vocab.sentence: She has already finished her homework.
